settings.heading: The seven day clarity reset
settings.text: Seven short exercises, one a day, to name what you want and choose your next step with confidence.
settings.points:
Ten minutes a day
Printable worksheets
A simple plan for the month ahead
settings.note: After the guide, a short letter on Sundays. Leave whenever you like.

settings.title: Days 1 to 3
settings.text: Notice: where your time and energy go, and what you keep putting off.

settings.title: Days 4 and 5
settings.text: Name: what you want more of, in plain words you would say out loud.

settings.title: Days 6 and 7
settings.text: Choose: one decision and three small steps for the month ahead.

settings.quote: Working with Leah was the first time a plan felt like mine. Three months later I have a new role and my Sundays back.
settings.author: Hannah, product manager
